events.title: Bullet Vendetta at the Ukrainian Games Festival 2026!

You’ll engage in shootouts and clear various city districts of enemies.I’d really appreciate your feedback after playing the demo! events.title: Bullet Vendetta Demo launches on August 17!
events.summary: Hi, everyone!I’d like to let you know that the demo for Bullet Vendetta will be available on August 17! I’ve also updated the game’s page and added new screenshots to show what Bullet Vendetta looks like right now.Now’s the time to add the game to your wishlist if you haven’t already. See you on August 17!
